## About
Pinnacle Point Clinic of Chiropractic offers a holistic and natural way to get healthy and stay that way. We look at more than the spot that hurts. We also consider your work and home stress, posture, nutrition and overall body condition.
Dr. F. Lynn Baldwin is a Life University graduate who has played sports his whole life, from football and basketball to golf and tennis. That background helps him understand athletes and their injuries. Dr. Jazmyn Smith earned her chiropractic degree from Parker University in Dallas. She focuses on family, pediatric and prenatal care, and she is a DONA trained Birth Doula and Certified Child Birth Educator.
Our patients have given us a 4.9 rating across 201 Google reviews. We are open Monday through Thursday, and we would be glad to see you.

## Services
- Chiropractic: Diagnosis and treatment for back pain using up-to-date chiropractic equipment.
- Physical therapy: Care starts with a full evaluation of where you hurt and what you can't do comfortably. When you finish, you get a personal home exercise program.
- Work injuries: A rehab program to help you get back to work after an on-the-job injury. We can consult with your employer and case manager if needed.
- Sports medicine: Rehab built around what athletes need to perform.
- Pilates: Exercises that work the deep spinal and core muscles so they function better.
- Massage therapy: Hands-on work on the soft tissues of the body.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the clinic?
A: We are at 2304 Bardin Rd, Ste. 201, in Grand Prairie.

Q: What days are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday. We are closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday, so please give us a call to find a time that works.

Q: What happens at my first physical therapy visit?
A: We start with a full assessment, including how you stand and move, so we can find the problem and plan your treatment.
